I saved the draft mail to Tobias and replied to June in her DM. Nothing has been sent; it waits in the drafts until a person sends it.

The draft goes to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate". It gives the Tansley Parcel proposed 2027 per-seat rate as $1,313 a seat and says June cleared it.

June can approve this because she's the deal desk, and finance figures can go to someone else with her OK. Tobias's address is internal (pemberline.com), so Ruth Calloway didn't need to approve it.
